newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank, Solidere shares steady in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Bank, Solidere shares steady in Beirut.

text.p: Bank shares were unchanged on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Friday as Audi shares held steady at $17.25 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce traded at $12.5.
Solidere A shares and B shares closed unchanged at $10.5 and $10.875 respectively.
Turnover in Audi shares fell to 17,231 shares from 53,730 shares a day earlier. Thursday's turnover included a bloc trade of 38,099 shares traded outside the floor at $17.25.
Turnover in Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce was 10,500 shares including a bloc of 2,500 shares traded inside the BSE at $12.25. On Thursday, 4,000 BLC shares changed hands.
There was no trade in the four other listed firms: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Uniceramic and Eternit.
Total BSE turnover was 81,505 shares for a value of $1,024,840 compared with Thursday's 67,828 shares for a value of $826,496.
The BLOM index was steady at 908.54 and the LISPI stock index was also unchanged at 81.58.
